pull: Clue: Named for an island off California
body:
Can you name this aircraft?

On 7 November 1942, one of these flying boats met a British submarine at sea and took aboard a French general who had been smuggled off the coast of Vichy France. It flew him to Gibraltar to meet Eisenhower, only hours before the Allied landings in North Africa.

The clue is on the card. Drop your guess below.
photoNote: U.S. Navy PBY-5A Catalina on patrol over the ocean, about 1942 to 1943 (radar fitted). U.S. Navy photo 80-G-K-14896, NARA 179036582, also on Commons as File:Consolidated_PBY-5A_Catalina_in_flight_c1942.jpg. Public domain. Not the aircraft that carried General Giraud, which was sent from Gibraltar.
photoCredit: A U.S. Navy PBY-5A Catalina on patrol over the ocean, about 1942. U.S. Navy 80-G-K-14896, National Archives, public domain.
